title: OpenAI sets retirement dates for Codex, TTS and other API models
friendlyTitle: Several OpenAI models now have shutdown dates
summary: OpenAI will remove GPT-5.3-Codex, GPT-5.4-Nano and GPT-5.1 from its API on April 1, 2027, and several text-to-speech models on January 6, 2027. The company recommends GPT-6 Sol or Luna for the text models and GPT Realtime 2.1 Mini for the retiring speech models.
friendlySummary: OpenAI will remove some Codex, general AI and voice models in early 2027. It has listed replacement models for developers to test.
whyItMatters: Applications tied to model names can fail on a fixed date even when their own code has not changed. Owners should inventory production dependencies, test replacements against real acceptance criteria and schedule migrations well before shutdown.
friendlyWhyItMatters: An app can stop working when its model disappears. Check which models you use and test replacements before the final date.
